text: Illustrate the story here: Zip the Tent Jaz and Zed went on a trip in a tent. Jaz sets up the tent. Zed helps. "Look at the pond," said Jaz. "Let's swim!" Jaz and Zed jump in the pond to swim. Jaz and Zed see lots of bugs. "You have to zip up the tent," said Jaz. "If you zip it, the bugs do not get in." Zed runs to the tent to zip it up. The bugs do not get in.
